7#[cfg(feature = "use_std")]
8mod io_writer {
9    use std::io;
10    use serde::Serialize;
11    use crate::core::utils::IoWriter;
12    use crate::serde::error::EncodeError;
13    use crate::serde::ser;
14
15    /// Serializes a value to a writer.
16    pub fn to_writer<W, T>(writer: W, value: &T)
17        -> Result<(), EncodeError<io::Error>>
18    where
19        W: io::Write,
20        T: Serialize
21    {
22        let writer = IoWriter::new(writer);
23        let mut writer = ser::Serializer::new(writer);
24        value.serialize(&mut writer)
25    }
26}
27
28mod buf_writer {
29    use crate::alloc::vec::Vec;
30    use crate::alloc::collections::TryReserveError;
31    use serde::Serialize;
32    use crate::core::utils::BufWriter;
33    use crate::serde::error::EncodeError;
34    use crate::serde::ser;
35
36    /// Serializes a value to a writer.
37    pub fn to_vec<T>(buf: Vec<u8>, value: &T)
38        -> Result<Vec<u8>, EncodeError<TryReserveError>>
39    where T: Serialize
40    {
41        let writer = BufWriter::new(buf);
42        let mut writer = ser::Serializer::new(writer);
43        value.serialize(&mut writer)?;
44        Ok(writer.into_inner().into_inner())
45    }
46}

48mod slice_reader {
49    use core::convert::Infallible;
50    use crate::core::utils::SliceReader;
51    use crate::serde::de;
52    use crate::serde::error::DecodeError;
53
54    /// Decodes a value from a bytes.
55    pub fn from_slice<'a, T>(buf: &'a [u8]) -> Result<T, DecodeError<Infallible>>
56    where
57        T: serde::Deserialize<'a>,
58    {
59        let reader = SliceReader::new(buf);
60        let mut deserializer = de::Deserializer::new(reader);
61        serde::Deserialize::deserialize(&mut deserializer)
62    }
63}
64
65#[cfg(feature = "use_std")]
66mod io_buf_reader {
67    use std::io::{ self, BufRead };
68    use crate::core::utils::IoReader;
69    use crate::serde::de;
70    use crate::serde::error::DecodeError;
71
72    /// Decodes a value from a reader.
73    pub fn from_reader<T, R>(reader: R) -> Result<T, DecodeError<io::Error>>
74    where
75        T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned,
76        R: BufRead
77    {
78        let reader = IoReader::new(reader);
79        let mut deserializer = de::Deserializer::new(reader);
80        serde::Deserialize::deserialize(&mut deserializer)
81    }
82}
